jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Infiterra**
===================

**Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.**

**Infiterra** enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

**Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.**

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

### **The role in a nutshell**

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

**Your goal?**
--------------

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

### **Our Ideal Candidate Profile**

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**
---------------------------

* Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
* Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
* A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
* Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
* Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.
* Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* **Feature Ownership:** Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
* **Technical Debt:** Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
* **Automated Testing:** Write robust automated tests.
* **Code Reviews:** Review your peers' pull requests.
* **Observability:** Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
* **Dependencies:** Surface cross-team dependencies early.
* **Clear Communication:** Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
* **AI-assisted Engineering:** Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

**What you'll bring:**
----------------------

* Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
* Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
* Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).
* Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.
* Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).
* Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).
* Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.
* Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.
* University degree in Computer Science or any related field.
* Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).
* Flexible working hours.
* Health and life insurance program.
* Learning & development budget.
* Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

**If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply!** **We’d love to hear from you!**

All applications will be treated with confidentiality. Please note that due to the high volume of CVs received, only candidates who are a good fit will be contacted for an interview.

As part of our commitment to diversity in the workforce, Infiterra is dedicated to Equal Employment Opportunity, ensuring that all individuals are treated with respect and consideration without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

jobs.title: Manager Software Engineering I Product Engineering Unit
jobs.description:
Je nieuwe baan

Wat ga je allemaal doen?
Als Manager Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een internationale softwareontwikkelafdeling van ruim 55 developers binnen de Product Engineering Unit van Blyce. De teams zijn verspreid over Europa, het Caribisch gebied en andere internationale locaties. Samen ontwikkel je innovatieve software die dagelijks impact heeft op miljoenen burgers wereldwijd en geef je richting aan de verdere groei, professionalisering en toekomst van de engineeringorganisatie.

Je rapporteert aan de Unit Manager Product Engineering en bent verantwoordelijk voor de mensen, de kwaliteit en de performance van de softwareontwikkelafdeling. In deze rol vorm je samen met de Manager Software Quality Engineering, Manager Platform Engineering en Manager Software Delivery het leiderschapsteam van de Product Engineering Unit. Je werkt nauw samen met de Delivery Coördinators voor de levering van producten en projecten bij klanten.
Je stuurt meerdere development teams, technical leads en senior engineers aan en creëert de structuur, samenwerking en executiekracht die nodig zijn om een groeiende internationale organisatie succesvol verder te ontwikkelen. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat engineering, testing, delivery en deployment als één geheel opereren.

In deze rol ligt de nadruk voor circa 70% op people leadership en voor 30% op proces en technologie. Je coacht medewerkers, ontwikkelt talent, bouwt high performing teams en zorgt ervoor dat de juiste mensen op de juiste plek zitten. Tegelijkertijd ben je technisch geloofwaardig genoeg om richting te geven aan belangrijke thema’s zoals softwarekwaliteit, testautomatisering, platformmodernisering, security, DevOps, CI/CD en AI-gedreven softwareontwikkeling. Blyce beweegt zich daarbij vanuit een installed base in low code richting C#/.NET en React.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

Leidinggeven aan en ontwikkelen van software engineers, teamleads en senior developers. Op dit moment bestaat de afdeling uit 55 developers en groeit deze geleidelijk door naar circa 65 medewerkers (eind 2027). Je denkt mee over de toekomstige organisatiestructuur, rapportagelijnen en onboarding, met als doel een beheersbare span of control van circa 5 tot 7 directe rapportages.
Verhogen van softwarekwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en leverbetrouwbaarheid.
Professionaliseren van engineeringprocessen, standaarden en kwaliteitsbewaking.
Bevorderen van samenwerking tussen Development, Testing, Delivery en Platform Engineering.
Verminderen van technical debt en bijdragen aan de verdere modernisering van het platform.
Verantwoord inzetten van AI binnen de softwareontwikkelcyclus.
Vertalen van de bedrijfsstrategie naar concrete verbeteringen binnen Software Engineering.
Bouwen aan een schaalbare engineeringorganisatie die klaar is voor verdere internationale groei.

Over het bedrijf

Waar kom je te werken?
Blyce ontwikkelt en levert bedrijfskritische software voor kleinschalige overheden en publieke organisaties met name in het Caribisch gebied en de Pacific. Met haar oplossingen helpt Blyce overheden om belastinginkomsten efficiënter te innen, zodat financiële middelen beschikbaar komen voor maatschappelijke voorzieningen zoals zorg, onderwijs en infrastructuur. Een mooi succesverhaal is Anguilla, waar de belastingopbrengsten in drie jaar tijd zijn verdubbeld. Daarnaast wordt momenteel een kantoor in Kuala Lumpur opgezet om een betere wereldwijde tijdzonedekking te realiseren.

De impact van het werk is daardoor direct zichtbaar. Zo hebben overheden dankzij de software van Blyce hun belastingopbrengsten aanzienlijk kunnen vergroten, waardoor investeringen mogelijk werden in publieke voorzieningen en economische ontwikkeling.

Blyce bevindt zich bovendien in een interessante groeifase. De organisatie groeit internationaal, breidt haar technologie verder uit en maakt de transitie van een projectgedreven naar een productgedreven organisatie. Dat betekent meer standaardisatie, moderne technologieën, schaalbare softwareplatformen en multidisciplinaire productteams.

Wat Blyce onderscheidt, is de combinatie van maatschappelijke relevantie, internationale dynamiek en de mogelijkheid om daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de toekomst van de softwareontwikkelingsafdeling. Hier ben je geen manager in een grote corporate structuur, maar een zichtbare leider die impact maakt op mensen, technologie én organisatie.

Wat we jou bieden

Een salaris tussen € 6.080 en € 8.100 bruto per maand, aangevuld met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder vakantiegeld, een extra maandvergoeding, een jaarlijkse bonus, een goede pensioenregeling en hybride werken.
Een sleutelrol binnen een internationaal softwarebedrijf met maatschappelijke impact, waarvan overheden dagelijks afhankelijk zijn.
De kans om een snelgroeiende internationale softwareontwikkelorganisatie verder vorm te geven en klaar te maken voor de toekomst.
Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en leiderschap, met doorgroeimogelijkheden richting een bredere management- of directierol binnen de Product Engineering Unit.
Een organisatie die volop investeert in innovatie, AI en moderne softwareontwikkeling, waarbij jij actief richting geeft aan deze ontwikkelingen.
Een internationale en multiculturele werkomgeving met volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, samenwerking en teamactiviteiten.

Wat we van jou verwachten

Wij zoeken een ervaren engineering manager die developers weet te inspireren, teams verder brengt en tegelijkertijd structuur, kwaliteit en resultaat realiseert.

Daarnaast breng je mee:
Ervaring met het aansturen van meerdere softwareontwikkelteams binnen een complexe of internationale organisatie.
Aantoonbare ervaring met coaching, performance management en teamontwikkeling.
Een sterke technische basis binnen moderne softwareontwikkelomgevingen.
Kennis van onderwerpen als enterprise software, cloud-native architecturen, API's, DevOps, CI/CD, security en softwarekwaliteit, evenals van C#/.NET en React.
Ervaring met het verbeteren van engineeringprocessen en delivery performance.
Affiniteit met AI en de toepassing daarvan binnen softwareontwikkeling.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende stakeholders te verbinden.
Een uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal. Nederlands is een pre.

Je bent een natuurlijke leider die rust brengt, draagvlak creëert en teams succesvol door verandering begeleidt. Je combineert strategisch inzicht met pragmatische executiekracht en weet mensen mee te krijgen in een gezamenlijke ambitie: het bouwen van software die dagelijks impact heeft op miljoenen burgers wereldwijd.

Procedure

De procedure bestaat uit een kennismaking met Executive Search Consultants Fleur van Maasdam, Johan van den Akker en Miana van der Kolk, gevolgd door twee gesprekken met opdrachtgever Blyce en een TMA-analyse.

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Tilburg University | Library & IT Services

is looking for a

Research Software Engineer

Department: IT Development, Team Tilburg AI
On site: Tilburg
Contract size: 0,7 – 1.0fte fte (28 - 40 hours per week)
Full-time gross monthly salary: €3.873 - €5.264
Contract duration: 12 - 48 months
Intended start date: November 1st 2026

Would you like to build open-source software that helps researchers make their work more transparent, verifiable, and reusable?

Tilburg University is looking for a Research Software Engineer for ReproHub
, a large-scale open science infrastructure project funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. In this role, you will work with researchers, research software engineers, library experts, student developers, Tilburg University’s AI development and cloud team (tilburg.ai), and national partners such as ODISSEI.

ReproHub develops infrastructure for researchers working with secondary and sensitive data. The project builds on existing Dutch open science infrastructure, including ODISSEI and Tilburg Science Hub, and aims to strengthen reproducibility, transparency, and public trust in science. 

Your position

As a research software engineer based at Library & Information Services at Tilburg University, you will contribute to the technical development and integration of ReproHub, a large-scale open science infrastructure project recently funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. Specifically, you will be part of the project’s technical development team and help translate stakeholder needs into reliable, maintainable, and secure software. 

ReproHub (see project proposal for details) consists of four connected deliverables: 
ReproBuddy: an AI tool based on open-source LLMs to improve reproducibility packages using commonly used workflows in the social sciences  
ReproRun: a system to validate research results and provide certificates 
OpenScienceRadar: a browser extension that makes open resources from public databases visible alongside search results (e.g., in Google Search) 
OpenScienceHub.nl: scaling Tilburg Science Hub to become a national platform with accessible educational material on Dutch and European open science infrastructure

Important activities include: 
Developing frontend and backend components for ReproHub’s tools and services; 
designing, building, and maintaining APIs and integrations between the different components; 
Contributing to API-based integration of LLM functionality, including context-retrieval approaches and open-source large language models; 
Helping build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployment workflows, and Kubernetes-based deployment; 
Developing and improving user interfaces for researchers, research support staff, and other users; 
Reviewing code, auditing pull requests, and maintaining technical documentation; 
Collaborating with student assistants and supporting them in writing high-quality, maintainable code; 
Translating stakeholder needs into technical choices, prototypes, and production-ready solutions; 
Contributing to software quality, security, privacy, reproducibility, and responsible AI practices. 

Your profile

Ability to work and think at an academic or bachelor level
At least 1 year of relevant experience as a full-stack developer, software engineer, research software engineer, or similar.
Minimum CEFR level C1 English and B2 Dutch.
Comfortable building web applications with Python and modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks, and has experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and writing clean, maintainable code.
Experience with API-based integration of LLM functionality, ideally including retrieval-augmented generation or related context-retrieval approaches, working with open-source large language models, and connecting AI components to web applications or research tools.
Experience with, or willingness to learn, technical infrastructure such as Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, cloud deployment, monitoring, and secure software development practices.
Understanding the importance of software quality, security, privacy, reproducibility, and responsible technology use, especially in research and open science contexts.
Enjoys working in a multidisciplinary team with researchers, developers, library experts, IT colleagues, and student assistants, and can translate user needs into practical technical solutions.
Is accurate, curious, pragmatic, and communicative; takes ownership of technical work while remaining open to feedback from users and colleagues.
Experience with open-source projects, research data workflows, browser extension development, university IT environments, or Dutch language skills is an advantage.

Our offer

Tilburg University offers excellent benefits in a pleasant working environment:
Employment of 0.7 – 1.0 fte (28 - 40 hours per week).
Salary between €3.873 - €5.264 gross per month for full-time employment (UFO-profile Engineering & Application Manager 4, salary scale 9). Tilburg University uses a neutral remuneration system based on relevant work experience.
This is a vacancy whose work is temporarily externally funded by NWO, You will be given a temporary contract for the duration of 12 months, which can be continued for a maximum duration of up to 48 months. 
Vacation pay of 8% and a year-end bonus of 8.3%.
Over 8 weeks of vacation leave.
Hybrid working with home working allowance (€2 p/day) and internet allowance (€25 p/month).
Reimbursement of sustainable commuting: walking, cycling, and public transport.
Options model for additional leave, pension, bicycle or personal training.
Moving allowance (subject to conditions).
30% rule for international employees (if applicable).
Pension through ABP.
Ample training offer: personal development, leadership, education, research or language courses.
Inclusive work culture: everyone welcome, equal opportunities.
A green, inviting campus that’s easily accessible by public transport.

For more information, please see our website and the CLA Dutch Universities.

Want to know more?

Would you like to know more before applying? Feel free to contact Coen van Houwelingen at c.h.vanhouwelingen@tilburguniversity.edu.

Want to apply?

We kindly invite you to apply before October 14th
; this can only be done online
. Address your cover letter to Coen van Houwelingen and attach your resume. We look forward to your response.

The selection committee consists of:
Coen van Houwelingen, Teamlead Software Development & Labsupport 
Hannes Datta, associate professor Tilburg School of Economics and Management (TiSEM)
Shrabastee Banerjee, assistant professor, TiSEM
Jessica Verheijen, community manager/data steward, Research Support, Library

You will ideally start working for Tilburg University on November 1st.

This vacancy has been published internally for 7 days, prior to being published externally. In case of equal suitability, our preference is for an internal candidate.

Due to safety considerations, a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) is part of the selection procedure.

About Tilburg University 

Tilburg University is the university in the humanities and social sciences. Ever since our foundation in 1927, we have been committed to a just, inclusive, and sustainable society. With leading research and inspiring education, we contribute to the interpretation and, where possible, solutions to current societal issues, from climate change to digitalization
Our community is personal, engaged, and small-scale. On our green, compact, and vibrant campus there is room for encounter, collaboration, reflection, and personal growth. Read more about Tilburg University.
Working at Tilburg University means working in an inclusive team with attractive employment conditions. At Tilburg University, you will receive ample opportunities to strengthen your talents and develop your career, in a warm working atmosphere where we attach great importance to the following values: curious, connected, caring, and courageous.

About the Library & IT Services Division (LIS)

The Library & IT Services Division (LIS) stands for the realization of state-of-the-art information provision; IT services; and library services for education, research, and business operations of Tilburg University. LIS positions itself as an advisor and service provider. From that position, we offer modern provisions in the field of information and information and communication technology. The Division is also responsible for academic information and library services. The Division has approximately 200 employees and consists of 6 organizational units; IT Services, IT Renewal, Projects & Information Services, CIO office, University Library and the university newspaper Univers. Read more about Library & IT Services | Tilburg University.

About Tilburg.AI

Tilburg.ai is Tilburg University’s innovation and development hub for AI applications within the university. Tilburg.ai also contributes to guidelines for AI usage and the promotion of AI literacy among students and staff.

Tilburg.ai operates according to a core principle: building with and for the Tilburg University community. The team works actively with students, faculty, researchers, and support staff to fully leverage the expertise within the university and align with organizational needs.
The foundation for AI innovation is a secure IT infrastructure. To achieve this, the Tilburg.ai team works alongside experts from Library and IT Services.
One of the main applications developed and managed by Tilburg.ai is Tilburg University’s own chatbot platform, Tilly.

Application code

Tilburg University applies the recruitment code of the Dutch Association for Personnel Management & Organization Development (NVP).

jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Java / AWS), Customer Contact Platform

12-month contract | €100 per hour | 40 hours per week

Location:
Amsterdam, hybrid with 2 office days per week (minimum 1 day with the team)

Our client is replacing its legacy customer contact systems with a single, unified contact centre platform built on Amazon Connect.

The platform brings together voice, chat, email and other customer channels, and it's already live in parts of the business. This is a long-running, multi-year programme, and you'll be helping extend it to new business areas.

You'll be integrating the platform with a range of internal systems, handling security and privacy requirements, and supporting reporting and data exports.

You'll join an established engineering group with strong domain knowledge, so you'll have support while you get up to speed.

What you'll do

Build and ship well-tested, maintainable software on AWS
Integrate new business areas and data sources into the platform
Own your services end to end: deployment, monitoring, metrics and documentation
Resolve live production issues and contribute to root cause analysis and postmortems
Work with colleagues across roles to design, prioritise and estimate technical work
Contribute to architecture discussions, weighing cost, requirements and future needs
Take part in an on-call rotation if required

What you'll bring

Strong commercial Java
experience
Hands-on AWS
experience, specifically Lambda, S3 and event-driven architectures
. The project is AWS-only, so experience on other clouds alone won't be enough
A solid approach to quality, including test automation and refactoring
Awareness of security, data privacy and integrity best practices
Clear communication and a collaborative approach in a multi-stakeholder environment

Nice to have

SRE experience
Amazon Connect experience (general AWS experience or certification is enough)
Contact centre or customer service technology background
